items.label: Climbing Obelisk Trellis
items.value: Discover the secret to a thriving garden with CL Fun's garden trellise! These garden obelisks provide generous space for your plants to flourish. Adjust their height with ease as your greenery grows, thanks to the detachable design. Plus, our garden obelisk trellis set comes with bonus plant clips for effortless guidance, ensuring strong support while preserving their beauty. Bid farewell to chaotic vines

items.label: Rust-proof & Weather-resistant Metal Trellis
items.value: Don't let rust spoil your garden's charm! Our rust-proof climbing rose trellis are built to endure the sun's harsh rays without fading. Its metal poles, protected by plastic casing, offer strong yet delicate support for your plants. The outdoor trellis sides have ribbed particles to help keep ties in place, it's ideal for both flowering vines and vegetable gardens

items.label: Sturdy & Compact Garden Trellis For Climbing Plants Outdoor
items.value: Say goodbye to wobbly plant trellis outdoor – our metal obelisk trellis features the latest plug-in connection and a unique double-layer metal tube built-in interface design to stay together more tightly and stably. Built tough to withstand hefty fruit loads, ensuring that your plant's fruits do not weigh down the stem and keeping your plants upright and elegant, bringing vitality to your home

items.label: Easy Assembly and Maintenance
items.value: Transforming your garden has never been easier! Our pot trellis requires no screws or any specialized tools for assembly - just follow the included instructions. Its detachable design ensures effortless disassembly and compact storage so that you can store these garden flower trellis for use next year. Additionally, the low-maintenance design allows you to focus more on enjoying your garden and less on upkeep

items.label: Versatile Garden Trellis For Climbing Plants
items.value: Create a mesmerizing garden oasis with our versatile multi-purpose garden trellis! Ideal for showcasing flowering vines like climbing roses, clematis and jasmine, or nurturing veggies like tomatoes and cucumbers. Plus, get creative with garlands for festive flair or fairy lights for enchanting evenings. Turn your outdoor space into a floral paradise or a whimsical wonderland—it's the ultimate decorative masterpiece for your yard or garden path

items.value: One pack plant trellis for climbing plants outdoor
